verdict.rationale: An observability dashboard for background jobs could plausibly offer AI-generated insights on run data, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no in-product AI insight or suggestion feature. The MCP server lets external AI assistants reach the projects from outside the product. The AI chat and prompt features are developer building blocks for building agents, and smart columns are JSON-path extraction, not AI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
